pli-tv-kd9:1.1.1: Tena samayena buddho bhagavā Campāyaṃ viharati Gaggarāya pokkharaṇiyā tīre.
pli-tv-kd9:1.1.2: tena kho pana samayena Kāsīsu janapadesu Vāsabhagāmo nāma hoti,
pli-tv-kd9:1.1.3: tattha Kassapagotto nāma bhikkhu āvāsiko hoti tantibaddho ussukkaṃ āpanno
pli-tv-kd9:1.1.4: kinti anāgatā ca pesalā bhikkhū āgaccheyyuṃ āgatā ca pesalā bhikkhū phāsu vihareyyuṃ ayaṃ ca āvāso vuddhiṃ virūḷhiṃ vepullaṃ āpajjeyyā 'ti.
pli-tv-kd9:1.1.5: tena kho pana samayena sambahulā bhikkhū Kāsīsu cārikaṃ caramānā yena Vāsabhagāmo tad avasaruṃ.
pli-tv-kd9:1.1.6: addasa kho Kassapagotto bhikkhu te bhikkhū dūrato 'va āgacchante, disvāna āsanaṃ paññāpesi pādodakaṃ pādapīṭhaṃ pādakathalikaṃ upanikkhipi paccuggantvā pattacīvaraṃ paṭiggahesi pāniyena āpucchi nahāne ussukkaṃ akāsi ussukkam pi akāsi yāguyā khādaniye bhattasmiṃ.
pli-tv-kd9:1.1.7: atha kho tesaṃ āgantukānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ etad ahosi:
pli-tv-kd9:1.1.8: bhaddako kho ayaṃ āvuso āvāsiko bhikkhu, nahāne ussukkaṃ karoti ussukkam pi karoti yāguyā khādaniye bhattasmiṃ,
pli-tv-kd9:1.1.9: handa mayaṃ āvuso idh' eva Vāsabhagāme nivāsaṃ kappemā 'ti.
pli-tv-kd9:1.1.10: atha kho te āgantukā bhikkhū tatth' eva Vāsabhagāme nivāsaṃ kappesuṃ. ||1||
pli-tv-kd9:1.2.1: atha kho Kassapagottassa bhikkhuno etad ahosi:
pli-tv-kd9:1.2.2: yo kho imesaṃ āgantukānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ āgantukakilamatho so paṭippassaddho,
pli-tv-kd9:1.2.3: ye p' ime gocare appakataññuno te dān' ime gocare pakataññuno.
pli-tv-kd9:1.2.4: dukkaraṃ kho pana parakulesu yāvajīvaṃ ussukkaṃ kātuṃ viññatti ca manussānaṃ amanāpā.
pli-tv-kd9:1.2.5: yaṃ nūnāhaṃ na ussukkaṃ kareyyaṃ yāguyā khādaniye bhattasmin ti.
pli-tv-kd9:1.2.6: so na ussukkaṃ akāsi yāguyā khādaniye bhattasmiṃ.
pli-tv-kd9:1.2.7: atha kho tesaṃ āgantukānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ etad ahosi:
pli-tv-kd9:1.2.8: pubbe khv' āyaṃ āvuso āvāsiko bhikkhu nahāne ussukkaṃ akāsi ussukkam pi akāsi yāguyā khādaniye bhattasmiṃ,
pli-tv-kd9:1.2.9: so dān' āyaṃ na ussukkaṃ karoti yāguyā khādaniye bhattasmiṃ.
pli-tv-kd9:1.2.10: duṭṭho dān' āyaṃ āvuso āvāsiko bhikkhu,
pli-tv-kd9:1.2.11: handa mayaṃ āvuso āvāsikaṃ bhikkhuṃ ukkhipāmā 'ti. ||2||
pli-tv-kd9:1.3.1: atha kho te āgantukā bhikkhū sannipatitvā Kassapagottaṃ bhikkhuṃ etad avocuṃ:
pli-tv-kd9:1.3.2: pubbe kho tvaṃ āvuso nahāne ussukkaṃ karosi ussukkam pi karosi yāguyā khādaniye bhattasmiṃ,
pli-tv-kd9:1.3.3: so dāni tvaṃ na ussukkaṃ karosi yāguyā khādaniye bhattasmiṃ.
pli-tv-kd9:1.3.6: n' atthi me āvuso āpatti yam ahaṃ passeyyan ti.
pli-tv-kd9:1.3.7: atha kho te āgantukā bhikkhū Kassapagottaṃ bhikkhuṃ āpattiyā adassane ukkhipiṃsu.
pli-tv-kd9:1.3.8: atha kho Kassapagottassa bhikkhuno etad ahosi:
pli-tv-kd9:1.3.9: ahaṃ kho etaṃ na jānāmi āpatti vā esā anāpatti vā āpanno c' amhi anāpanno vā ukkhitto c' amhi anukkhitto vā dhammikena vā adhammikena vā kuppena vā akuppena vā ṭhānārahena vā aṭṭhānārahena vā.
pli-tv-kd9:1.3.10: yaṃ nūnāhaṃ Campaṃ gantvā bhagavantaṃ etaṃ atthaṃ puccheyyan ti. ||3||
pli-tv-kd9:1.4.1: atha kho Kassapagotto bhikkhu senāsanaṃ saṃsāmetvā pattacīvaraṃ ādāya yena Campā tena pakkāmi,
pli-tv-kd9:1.4.2: anupubbena yena Campā yena bhagavā ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi.
pli-tv-kd9:1.4.3: āciṇṇaṃ kho pan' etaṃ buddhānaṃ bhagavantānaṃ āgantukehi bhikkhūhi saddhiṃ paṭisammodituṃ.
pli-tv-kd9:1.4.4: atha kho bhagavā Kassapagottaṃ bhikkhuṃ etad avoca:

pli-tv-kd9:1.5.2: tatthāhaṃ bhagavā āvāsiko tantibaddho ussukkaṃ āpanno
pli-tv-kd9:1.5.3: kinti anāgatā ca pesalā bhikkhū āgaccheyyuṃ āgatā ca pesalā bhikkhū phāsu vihareyyuṃ ayaṃ ca āvāso vuddhiṃ virūḷhiṃ vepullaṃ āpajjeyyā 'ti.
pli-tv-kd9:1.5.4: atha kho bhante sambahulā bhikkhū Kāsīsu cārikaṃ caramānā yena Vāsabhagāmo tad avasaruṃ.
pli-tv-kd9:1.5.5: addasaṃ kho ahaṃ bhante bhikkhū dūrato 'va āgacchante, disvāna āsanaṃ paññāpesiṃ . . .
pli-tv-kd9:1.5.6: atha kho tesaṃ bhante āgantukānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ etad ahosi:
pli-tv-kd9:1.5.9: atha kho te bhante āgantukā bhikkhū tatth' eva Vāsabhagāme nivāsaṃ kappesuṃ.
pli-tv-kd9:1.5.15: so kho ahaṃ bhante na ussukkaṃ akāsiṃ . . .
pli-tv-kd9:1.5.17: nahāne ussukkaṃ karoti ussukkam pi karoti yāguyā khādaniye bhattasmiṃ,
pli-tv-kd9:1.5.18: so dān' āyaṃ na ussukkaṃ karoti . . .
pli-tv-kd9:1.5.21: atha kho te bhante āgantukā bhikkhū sannipatitvā maṃ etad avocuṃ:
pli-tv-kd9:1.5.27: atha kho te bhante āgantukā bhikkhū maṃ āpattiyā adassane ukkhipiṃsu.
pli-tv-kd9:1.5.29: ahaṃ kho . . . puccheyyan ti. tato ahaṃ bhagavā āgacchāmīti. ||5|| anāpatti esā bhikkhu n' esā āpatti, anāpanno 'si na 'si āpanno, anukkhitto 'si na 'si ukkhitto, adhammikena 'si
pli-tv-kd9:1.6.5: gaccha tvaṃ bhikkhu tatth' eva Vāsabhagāme nivāsaṃ kappehīti.
pli-tv-kd9:1.6.6: evaṃ bhante 'ti kho Kassapagotto bhikkhu bhagavato paṭisuṇitvā uṭṭhāyāsanā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā yena Vāsabhagāmo tena pakkāmi. ||6||
pli-tv-kd9:1.7.1: atha kho tesaṃ āgantukānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ ahud eva kukkuccaṃ ahu vippaṭisāro:
pli-tv-kd9:1.7.2: alābhā vata no na vata no lābhā,
pli-tv-kd9:1.7.3: dulladdhaṃ vata no na vata no suladdhaṃ, ye mayaṃ suddhaṃ bhikkhuṃ anāpattikaṃ avatthusmiṃ akāraṇe ukkhipimhā.
pli-tv-kd9:1.7.4: handa mayaṃ āvuso Campaṃ gantvā bhagavato santike accayaṃ accayato desemā 'ti.
pli-tv-kd9:1.7.5: atha kho te āgantukā bhikkhū senāsanaṃ saṃsāmetvā pattacīvaraṃ ādāya yena Campā tena pakkamiṃsu,
pli-tv-kd9:1.7.6: anupubbena yena Campā yena bhagavā ten' upasaṃkamiṃsu, upasaṃkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdiṃsu.
pli-tv-kd9:1.7.8: atha kho bhagavā te bhikkhū etad avoca:
pli-tv-kd9:1.7.13: appakilamathena ca mayaṃ bhante addhānaṃ āgatā.
pli-tv-kd9:1.7.14: atthi bhante Kāsīsu janapadesu Vāsabhagāmo nāma,
pli-tv-kd9:1.8.7: kathaṃ hi nāma tumhe moghapurisā suddhaṃ bhikkhuṃ anāpattikaṃ avatthusmiṃ akāraṇe ukkhipissatha.
pli-tv-kd9:1.8.8: n' etaṃ moghapurisā appasannānaṃ vā pasādāya.
pli-tv-kd9:1.8.9: vigarahitvā dhammiṃ kathaṃ katvā bhikkhū āmantesi:
pli-tv-kd9:1.8.10: na bhikkhave suddho bhikkhu anāpattiko avatthusmiṃ akāraṇe ukkhipitabbo.
pli-tv-kd9:1.9.1: atha kho te bhikkhū uṭṭhāyāsanā ekaṃsaṃ uttarāsaṅgaṃ karitvā bhagavato pādesu sirasā nipatitvā bhagavantaṃ etad avocuṃ:
pli-tv-kd9:1.9.2: accayo no bhante accagamā yathā bāle yathā mūḷhe yathā akusale ye mayaṃ suddhaṃ bhikkhuṃ anāpattikaṃ avatthusmiṃ akāraṇe ukkhipimhā,
pli-tv-kd9:1.9.3: tesaṃ no bhante bhagavā accayaṃ accayato paṭigaṇhātu āyatiṃ saṃvarāyā 'ti.
pli-tv-kd9:1.9.4: taggha tumhe bhikkhave accayo accagamā yathā bāle yathā mūḷhe yathā akusale ye tumhe suddhaṃ bhikkhuṃ anāpattikaṃ avatthusmiṃ akāraṇe ukkhipittha.
pli-tv-kd9:1.9.5: yato ca kho tumhe bhikkhave accayaṃ accayato disvā yathādhammaṃ paṭikarotha taṃ vo mayaṃ paṭigaṇhāma,
pli-tv-kd9:1.9.6: vuddhi h' esā bhikkhave ariyassa vinaye yo accayaṃ accayato disvā yathādhammaṃ paṭikaroti āyatiṃ saṃvaraṃ āpajjatīti. ||9||1||
pli-tv-kd9:2.1.1: tena kho pana samayena Campāyaṃ bhikkhū evarūpāni kammāni karonti:
pli-tv-kd9:2.1.2: adhammena vaggakammaṃ karonti, adhammena samaggakammaṃ karonti,
pli-tv-kd9:2.1.3: dhammena vaggak. k., dhammapaṭirūpakena vaggak. k.,
pli-tv-kd9:2.1.5: eko pi ekaṃ ukkhipati, eko pi dve ukkhipati, eko pi sambahule ukkhipati, eko pi saṃghaṃ ukkh.,
pli-tv-kd9:2.1.6: dve pi ekaṃ ukkhipanti, dve pi dve ukkh., dve pi sambahule ukkh., dve pi saṃghaṃ ukkh.,
pli-tv-kd9:2.1.8: sambahulāpi dve ukkh., sambahulāpi sambahule ukkh., sambahulāpi saṃghaṃ ukkh., saṃgho
pli-tv-kd9:2.2.1: ye te bhikkhū appicchā te ujjhāyanti khīyanti vipācenti:
pli-tv-kd9:2.2.2: kathaṃ hi nāma Campāyaṃ bhikkhū evarūpāni kammāni karissanti:
pli-tv-kd9:2.2.3: adhammena vaggakammaṃ karissanti, . . . dhammapaṭirūpakena samaggakammaṃ karissanti, eko pi ekaṃ ukkhipissati . . . saṃgho pi saṃghaṃ ukkhipissatīti.
pli-tv-kd9:2.2.4: atha kho te bhikkhū bhagavato etam atthaṃ arocesuṃ.
pli-tv-kd9:2.2.5: saccaṃ kira bhikkhave Campāyaṃ bhikkhū evarūpāni kammāni karonti:
pli-tv-kd9:2.2.10: ananucchaviyaṃ bhikkhave tesaṃ moghapurisānaṃ ananulomikaṃ . . . akaraṇīyaṃ.
pli-tv-kd9:2.2.11: kathaṃ hi nāma te bhikkhave moghapurisā evarūpāni kammāni karissanti:
pli-tv-kd9:2.2.14: n' etaṃ bhikkhave appasannānaṃ vā pasādāya.
pli-tv-kd9:2.3.1: adhammena ce bhikkhave vaggakammaṃ akammaṃ na ca karaṇīyaṃ.
pli-tv-kd9:2.3.2: adhammena samaggakammaṃ akammaṃ na ca karaṇīyaṃ . . .
pli-tv-kd9:2.3.5: dhammapaṭirūpakena samaggakammaṃ akammaṃ na ca karaṇīyaṃ,
pli-tv-kd9:2.3.6: eko pi ekaṃ ukkhipati akammaṃ na ca karaṇīyaṃ . . .
pli-tv-kd9:2.3.7: saṃgho pi saṃghaṃ ukkhipati akammaṃ na ca karaṇīyaṃ. ||3||
pli-tv-kd9:2.4.2: adhammena vaggakammaṃ, adhammena samaggakammaṃ, dhammena vaggakammaṃ, dhammena samaggakammaṃ.

pli-tv-kd9:2.4.9: tatra bhikkhave yam idaṃ dhammena samaggakammaṃ idaṃ bhikkhave kammaṃ dhammattā samaggattā akuppaṃ ṭhānārahaṃ.
pli-tv-kd9:2.4.10: evarūpaṃ bhikkhave kammaṃ kātabbaṃ evarūpaṃ ca mayā kammaṃ anuññātaṃ.
